description: Use ONLY for an owner/platform-preauthorized autonomous purchase of one of four supported micro-services under an explicit spending cap. Unlike prepare_repair, this tool does not consume an existing quoteId: it creates its own quote, accepts it, and creates checkout within the delegation. Repeating the call may create a new quote/checkout, so it is intentionally non-idempotent. Do NOT use it when quote_repair already produced a quoteId or for general repair services outside the four listed micro-services; use prepare_repair for an existing repair quote. Supports wallet rails and APPLE_PAY_AUTO. APPLE_PAY_AUTO requires one human Apple Pay approval first; when Tap returns an ACTIVE saved-card payment agreement, later purchases may be charged only within the stored cap. If provider support or authorization is missing, the flow fails closed.

applePayAuthorizationToken.description: Opaque token returned by the one-time APPLE_PAY_AUTO setup. Supply only a token from this delegated authorization flow; never provide card data or raw Apple Pay payloads.

authorizeCheckout.description: Explicit permission for this tool to create its own quote, accept it, and create checkout within the supplied cap. If a quoteId already exists, use prepare_repair instead.

authorizedMerchant.description: Merchant scope explicitly authorized by the owner/platform for this delegated purchase flow.

dailyLimitUsd.description: Requested daily APPLE_PAY_AUTO cap used only during first-time authorization setup; maximum 20 USD.

description.description: Sanitized bounded work description for the delegated micro-service; never include secrets, credentials or private keys.

maxAmountUsd.description: Owner/platform per-purchase spending cap in USD-equivalent. The quote must fit inside this cap and the service launch price.

paymentRail.description: Delegated-purchase rail policy. AUTO chooses an eligible wallet rail; APPLE_PAY_AUTO uses or establishes the capped Tap authorization. This is not the manual rail selection for prepare_repair.

productId.description: Exactly one of the four services allowed for delegated purchase. For any other repair service, use diagnose_issue → quote_repair → prepare_repair.

source.description: Optional attribution label for the calling agent or integration.

name: request_delegated_purchase

outputSchema.description: Result of a capped delegated purchase attempt. For wallet rails, success creates and accepts a quote plus checkout and returns PAYMENT_REQUIRED with payer instructions; payment itself remains external. For APPLE_PAY_AUTO, first use may return ONE_TIME_APPLE_PAY_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED with human authorization data, while a later call with an ACTIVE authorization token may return provider payment-verification fields. Treat error or a non-confirmed status as not paid. This schema describes the delegated flow only; normal existing-quote repairs use prepare_repair.

authorization.description: APPLE_PAY_AUTO authorization setup/status information, potentially including the one-time human authorization URL/token. Never interpret this object alone as payment success.

automaticAcceptance.description: True when the delegated quote was automatically accepted under explicit owner/platform authorization.

automaticCheckout.description: True when this tool created checkout under the delegation.

automaticExecution.description: False until the existing post-payment workflow has verified payment; this tool does not execute unpaid work.

automaticJob.description: False when no verified-payment job has been attached yet.

automaticPayment.description: False for wallet flows and authorization setup; may only become provider-driven within a previously ACTIVE APPLE_PAY_AUTO agreement.

automaticQuote.description: True when this tool created the delegated quote itself.

checkoutId.description: Checkout created by this delegated call when quote creation/acceptance succeeded.

delegatedAuthorization.description: Echo of the enforced merchant/spending delegation, including cap and whether quote acceptance/checkout creation were authorized.

details.description: Bounded provider/commerce error details when available.

error.description: Fail-closed error code when delegation, price, provider authorization, quote, checkout, or payment requirements are not satisfied.

job.description: Repair/delivery job attached by the existing verified-payment workflow when available; may be null.

nextTool.description: For wallet rails, verify_checkout_payment after the payer submits the exact transfer.

nextToolArguments.description: Suggested verification arguments for the wallet checkout; txHash remains caller-supplied after payment.

payerAction.description: Required human/payer action before payment can be considered complete.

paymentId.description: Verified payment identifier when returned by the provider flow.

paymentInstructions.description: Wallet transfer instructions for an existing delegated checkout; the tool does not send the transfer.

paymentRail.description: Rail actually selected for this delegated purchase.

productId.description: One of the four delegated micro-service product identifiers.

quoteId.description: Quote created by this delegated call. It was not supplied by the caller.

status.description: Delegated-purchase state such as PAYMENT_REQUIRED, ONE_TIME_APPLE_PAY_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED, APPLE_PAY_AUTHORIZATION_NOT_ACTIVE, or a provider payment state.

verified.description: When returned by the provider flow, true only for a verified payment.

title: Delegated Purchase (Capped)
